name: QuoteDeck
description: Insurance SaaS for agents/agencies to create and present professional life & health quotes (vs screenshots, messy PDFs, phone chase). Solo founder, bootstrapped. ~$60–$140/mo.

mentions.evidence: ~$2.1k MRR, 11 active subscriptions, ~$1.2k L30, ~$17.5k all-time, team of 1, founded Nov 2025, US. Last sync Sep 30, 2026. (Listed for sale on TrustMRR marketplace recently.)
mentions.indieAngle: Most solo-plausible vertical of the day — one licensed niche, quote → signature → compliance.
